name: SFTP Producer
helpText:
SFTP Producer

Ending component of the flow, or a route in the flow. This producer allows delivery of a file to remote (S)FTP server. The producer is under pined with persistent store which saves meta information about the deliver files.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

checksumDelivered.helpText: Default(false) Flag indicating whether producer should generate and deliver a checksum md5 hash file to remote server.

cleanupChunks.helpText: Default(true) Flag indicating whether chunk file information persisted in DB should be removed by producer after successful file delivery aka. successful file assembling from chunks.

cleanupJournalOnComplete.helpText: Only set to false when debugging. When true (default) the journal information is deleted whe the file is processed successfully. The journal is a durable log of in-progress FTP operations, letting the connector detect and safely replay/resolve transactions interrupted by a crash — instead of losing or duplicating file processing.

clientID.helpText: ClientID is used in the persisted meta data to identify this component uniquely in the context of the module. Since a flow can only have 1 consumer, the flow name makes for a good, default, client ID.

configuration.helpText: Provide the classname that overrides and implements the default FileConsumerConfiguration interface. The class encapsulates all the properties here into a single bean, using it will reduce your ability to configure the component within this tool
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

connectionTimeout.helpText: Internal (S)FTP connector connection timeout value in milliseconds. Default is 60000 (1 minute).

createParentDirectory.helpText: Default(false) Flag indicating whether outputDirectory should be created if it does not exist.

criticalOnStartup.helpText: Default(False). Identify this component as being critical for starting the flow i.e. if the component fails to start, the whole flow will not start.

knownHostFilename.helpText: The location of the known hosts file.

outputDirectory.helpText: Remote directory where to deliver the file.

password.helpText: Password used to login to (S)FTP server where consumer needs to connect. Takes precedences over privateKeyFilename. If both provided user/password combination will be used to login rather then user/privateKeyFilename.

remoteHost.helpText: Default('localhost') host name of the remote (S)FTP server where consumer needs to connect.

remotePort.helpText: Default(22) port of the remote (S)FTP server where consumer needs to connect.

renameExtension.helpText: Default('tmp') file delivery to remote location takes place in two stages, first a file is delivered with suffix equal to renameExtension, further file is renamed with suffix being removed.

tempFileName.helpText: Temporary filename to use for incomplete transfer.

unzip.helpText: Default(false) Flag indicating whether the file should be unzipped on remote server as post delivery task. This makes an assumption that delivered stream is zipped.

username.helpText: User name used to login to (S)FTP server where consumer needs to connect.
